newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision denies Classic Sports charge.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision denies Classic Sports charge.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp said on Monday that it is denying Classic Sports Network's charges that it broke the Cable Act of 1992 by trying to force Classic Sports into a deal.

Classic Sports Network said earlier today that it intends to file a complaint with the Federal Communications Commission that accuses Cablevision of trying to coerce the sports channel into granting Cablevision an equity stake, or exclusive distribution rights.
"Cablevision is and always has been in full compliance with all FCC regulations," the company said.
Cablevision said it has never demanded equity as the Classic Sports's price of being carried on the cable systems.
Cablevision said it carries many cable program services, but it only owns equity in the networks it has created, or those it presently operates.
A complaint from Classic Sports has not yet been filed with the FCC, Cablevision said.
Classic Sports had said available remedies and sanctions the FCC could take include forfeitures, mandatory carriage or carried under terms made by the FCC.
